tasks.title: Encode the position of an OSD element
tasks.solution: OSD_POS(x, y) = (x & 31) | ((x << 5) & 0x400) | (y << 5): the low 5 bits of x go to bits 0–4, bit 5 of x goes to bit 10 (the value 1024), and y goes to bits 5–9. Visibility in profile p is bit 10 + p: 2048, 4096 or 8192. Add everything up. If x ≤ 31, bit 10 is not needed.

tasks.title: Decode the column of an element
tasks.solution: OSD_X(v) = (v & 31) | ((v & 0x400) >> 5): take the low 5 bits and add 32 if bit 10 is set (v & 1024 ≠ 0). Bits 5–9 are y, bits 11–13 are the profiles, 14–15 are the variant; they do not affect x. Example: 3118 & 31 = 14, bit 10 is set → x = 46.

tasks.title: Enable a warning in the 2025.12 mask
tasks.solution: Setting bit N is a bitwise OR: mask | 2^N. If the bit is already set (for example, 405503 already contains bit 13 = 8192), the number does not change — plain addition would give a wrong mask. 397311 is the 2025.12 default, where bits 12–16 (RSSI, LINK_QUALITY, RSSI_DBM, OVER_CAP, RSNR) are off.
